dct_title_s: Indonesia Cyclone Seroja: Damage Proxy Maps, Apr 2021
dct_description_sm: # Indonesia Cyclone Seroja: Damage Proxy Maps, Apr 2021 The Advanced Rapid Imaging and Analysis (ARIA) team at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory and Caltech, in collaboration with the Earth Observatory of Singapore (EOS), produced these damage proxy maps for Indonesia Cyclone Seroja (Apr 2021) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **Peta Kerusakan ARIA-SG: Siklon Seroja, Indonesia, 6 April 2021, v0.8** - **Peta Kerusakan ARIA-SG: Siklon Seroja, Indonesia, 6 April 2021, v0.8** **More map details and files:**
